audience: HR and operations teams that manage absences, schedules and time records in tipee

useCases.title: See who is absent in a period
useCases.text: List the absence types of the instance, then the absences in a date range. See who is off and for which kind of absence.

useCases.title: Map employees to their teams
useCases.text: List the employees with their teams, or show the team assignments of one employee. Open one team to read its details.

useCases.title: Compare work schedules with absences
useCases.text: List the work schedules of some employees in a date range. Read the absences of the same period next to them.

useCases.title: Check time clock entries
useCases.text: List the time clock entries that match your filters. Use the filters to narrow the list before you read it.

useCases.title: Summarize logged hours by validation status
useCases.text: Show the summed durations of activities that match your filters, split by validation status. List the activities to see the detail behind a total.

useCases.title: Browse projects, tasks and day tasks
useCases.text: Open a project to see its members, then list its tasks. List the day tasks of some employees over a date range.
